existing_rows.q: Welcome back. Amy! I missed you. Did you have a nice time at the summer camp?
existing_rows.a: Yes. I had a great time. But I missed you too!

existing_rows.q: Oh dear. What happened to your arm?
existing_rows.a: I fell down and broke it.

existing_rows.q: We played all day. Amy was very tired. Then she had an accident. She fell down the stairs of the tree house and broke her arm.
My friend Ann heard me fall. She called a teacher and I went to hospital.
Did you still had a good time at summer camp?
existing_rows.a: Oh yes. We had a great time. We played lots of sports. we went swimming every day! Look- My friends wrote their names.
